scope: Gprof function profiles and separate GNU time accounting for three original saved CORE successes.

profiling.coverage: Function-level sampled self time and instrumented call counts; no source annotation. External SAT uninstrumented; dependency/shared-library coverage incomplete; child times estimated.

initial_clock_profiling_failure.error: expected one gmon file per instrumented executable
initial_clock_profiling_failure.diagnostic: mcount: call graph buffer size limit exceeded, gmon.out will not be generated

result: Producer accounts for about 71-74% of combined baseline CPU. Kernel samples mainly number decoding and replay. Large primitive proof volumes and busy definition/stream symbols motivate author investigation; no checker optimization implemented.

command:
set -uo pipefail
export TIME="$8"
prlimit --as=3221225472 --fsize=268435456 -- \
  "$9" -o "$6/producer.time" \
  env GMON_OUT_PREFIX="$6/producer.gmon" \
  "$1" "$2" "$3" - --raw --cadical "$4" 2> "$6/producer.err" |
prlimit --as=3221225472 --fsize=268435456 -- \
  "$9" -o "$6/kernel.time" \
  env GMON_OUT_PREFIX="$6/kernel.gmon" \
  "$5" "$2" - > "$6/kernel.out" 2> "$6/kernel.err"
statuses=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
printf '%s %s\n' "${statuses[0]}" "${statuses[1]}" > "$6/exit-status.txt"
if (( statuses[0] != 0 || statuses[1] != 0 )); then exit 1; fi
grep -Fxq 'challenge proven' "$6/kernel.out"
! grep -Fxq 'Inconsistency proven!' "$6/kernel.out"

user_seconds=%U
system_seconds=%S
elapsed_seconds=%e
max_rss_kib=%M
voluntary_switches=%w
involuntary_switches=%c
filesystem_inputs=%I
filesystem_outputs=%O
exit_status=%x
